surveyTemplate.name: ISO 20000-1 SMS Transformation Pulse
surveyTemplate.description: Lightweight recurring pulse covering the ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018 clause groups, with emphasis on the Operation (service management process) domain. Complements full ISO 20000-1 Assessments (04-import.md/03-manual-entry.md) with a quarterly SMS maturity check-in (07-survey.md). Note: OPS-xx codes referenced here are the curated items defined in 10-iso20000.md §3.5, pending verification against the official standard text.

questions.prompt: Is the scope of the service management system (SMS) clearly defined and documented?
Does top management actively demonstrate leadership/commitment to the SMS?
Are service management objectives set and measurable, with plans to achieve them?
Is competence of SMS-relevant personnel ensured (training, qualification, experience)?
Is the service portfolio defined, agreed, and kept current?
Are service level agreements actively managed with business/customers/suppliers?
Is capacity/demand for services planned ahead of predictable changes?
Are incidents resolved against agreed service levels, with clear ownership?
Is root-cause (problem management) analysis performed to prevent incident recurrence?
Are availability commitments tracked and met against agreed SLAs?
Are changes to services/components controlled through a managed, risk-aware change process?
Are internal audits of the SMS planned and conducted regularly?
Are nonconformities identified and corrective actions tracked to closure?

_notes.perDomainBreakdown: 1 each for C4/C5/C6/C7, 6 for OPS (Operation, the highest-real-world-weight domain), 1 for C9, 1 for C10 - within the 10-30 recommended range in 07-survey.md
_notes.responseModel: Each SurveyResponse uses SurveyResponseLevel (VeryLow..VeryHigh, NotApplicable) per 02-data-model.md; optional numeric Score override.
_notes.domainCode/controlCode: Resolved to DomainId/ControlId at seed time by joining against the iso20000.json fixture (Framework must be seeded first).
